answer: Because the trellis fee is applied at the zephyr exit, the dawn audit totals the burn and the ledger makes public exactly what left. Withdrawing stake costs a 8% fee that is burned rather than redistributed, so moving capital between aliases destroys a slice of it every time. An operator rotating funds across many keys therefore bleeds value on each hop, which is a cost an agent that leaves its stake in place never pays. That is 21 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
